{"create_table": "CREATE TABLE [dbo].[leadCaptures] (
    leadCaptureId INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    companyId INT NULL,
    fullName NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    email NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    companyName NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
    phone NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
    jobTitle NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    message NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
    leadSource NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    interestArea NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
    status NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    assignedTo INT NULL,
    privacyConsentAccepted BIT NOT NULL,
    created_At DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    updated_at DATETIME NULL,
    CONSTRAINT PK_leadCaptures PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (leadCaptureId ASC)
);
GO

GO", "sp_upsert": "CREATE OR ALTER PROC [dbo].[sp_leadCaptures]
    @pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Outputmessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = '{
  "result": [
    {{ "value": "", "msg": "", "error": "" }}
  ]
}'
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    DECLARE @action INT = (
        SELECT TOP 1 TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.action'))
        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures')
    );

    DECLARE @payload TABLE (
        leadCaptureId           INT NULL,
        companyId               INT NULL,
        fullName                NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        email                   NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        companyName             NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
        phone                   NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        jobTitle                NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        message                 NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        leadSource              NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        interestArea            NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        status                  NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        assignedTo              INT NULL,
        privacyConsentAccepted  BIT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO @payload (
        leadCaptureId,
        companyId,
        fullName,
        email,
        companyName,
        phone,
        jobTitle,
        message,
        leadSource,
        interestArea,
        status,
        assignedTo,
        privacyConsentAccepted
    )
    SELECT
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadCaptureId')),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyId')),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.fullName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.email'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.phone'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.jobTitle'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.message'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadSource'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.interestArea'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.status'),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.assignedTo')),
        TRY_CONVERT(BIT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.privacyConsentAccepted'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures');

    -- Validate privacyConsentAccepted for INSERT action (Public submission constraint)
    IF @action = 1
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @payload WHERE ISNULL(privacyConsentAccepted, 0) = 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Privacy consent must be accepted to create a lead.');
            GOTO Finish;
        END
    END;

    -- Declare variable for normalized email for duplicate checks
    DECLARE @normalizedEmail NVARCHAR(150);

    -- Check for duplicates within the payload itself (normalized email, considering companyId as NULL for public leads)
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM @payload
        GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(email)), ISNULL(companyId, 0) -- ISNULL to treat all NULL companyIds as a single group for this check
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
        SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate lead entries within the payload for the same normalized email and company context.');
        GOTO Finish;
    END

    IF @action = 1 -- INSERT
    BEGIN
        -- Check for conflicts against the existing table (normalized email)
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON LOWER(TRIM(lc.email)) = LOWER(TRIM(p.email))
                                 AND (lc.companyId = p.companyId OR (lc.companyId IS NULL AND p.companyId IS NULL))
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Lead with this normalized email already exists for this company context.');
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        INSERT INTO dbo.leadCaptures (
            companyId,
            fullName,
            email,
            companyName,
            phone,
            jobTitle,
            message,
            leadSource,
            interestArea,
            status,
            assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted,
            created_At
        )
        SELECT
            p.companyId,
            p.fullName,
            p.email,
            p.companyName,
            p.phone,
            p.jobTitle,
            p.message,
            p.leadSource,
            p.interestArea,
            ISNULL(p.status, 'new'), -- Default status to 'new' for new leads
            p.assignedTo,
            p.privacyConsentAccepted,
            GETDATE()
        FROM @payload p;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 2 -- UPDATE
    BEGIN
        -- Check for conflicts against existing table, excluding the record being updated itself (normalized email)
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON LOWER(TRIM(lc.email)) = LOWER(TRIM(p.email))
                                 AND (lc.companyId = p.companyId OR (lc.companyId IS NULL AND p.companyId IS NULL))
            WHERE lc.leadCaptureId <> p.leadCaptureId
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Lead with this normalized email already exists for this company context.');
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        UPDATE lc
        SET
            companyId               = p.companyId,
            fullName                = p.fullName,
            email                   = p.email,
            companyName             = p.companyName,
            phone                   = p.phone,
            jobTitle                = p.jobTitle,
            message                 = p.message,
            leadSource              = p.leadSource,
            interestArea            = p.interestArea,
            status                  = ISNULL(p.status, lc.status), -- Preserve existing status if not provided
            assignedTo              = p.assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted  = p.privacyConsentAccepted,
            updated_at              = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 3 -- DELETE
    BEGIN
        DELETE lc
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END

    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Inserted/Updated/Deleted Successfully');
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

Finish:
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', ERROR_MESSAGE());
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');
END CATCH

        ISNULL([email], '') AS email,
        ISNULL([companyName], '') AS companyName,
        ISNULL([phone], '') AS phone,

        ISNULL([message], '') AS message,

        ISNULL([privacyConsentAccepted], 0) AS privacyConsentAccepted,
